# TopologyAwareMapping

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The strategy of mapping spiking neural network structures onto physical interconnect topologies to minimize communication overhead. Enhances performance and energy efficiency in neuromorphic systems by aligning computational graph with hardware connectivity.
